 --> Diwali school holidays 2026: Check state-wise closure dates, extended vacations and reopening schedule
 Diwali 2026 school holidays vary across states, with Rajasthan and Bihar getting extended breaks. Check state-wise closure dates, festival holidays and school reopening schedules. 
 Sheetal Kumari 
 November 05, 2026 / 12:55 IST Share --> 
 --> 
 --> 
 --> 
 Diwali school holidays 2026 Schools across Indian states announce Diwali 2026 holidays.
 Vacation dates and durations vary significantly by state.
 Parents should check local school calendars for exact dates.

 Schools across several Indian states are preparing for Diwali holidays in November 2026, with students set to receive breaks of varying lengths depending on regional festival calendars. While Diwali falls on November 8, a Sunday, several states have announced additional holidays for celebrations such as Govardhan Puja, Bhai Dooj, Kali Puja and Chhath Puja.
 Rajasthan and Bihar are among the states with extended school vacations this year. Schools in Rajasthan are observing a mid-term break from November 4 to November 15, with regular classes scheduled to resume on November 16. In Bihar, government schools will remain closed from November 7 to November 17, covering several festivals following Diwali.
 Other states, including Uttar Pradesh, West Bengal, Assam, Odisha and Jharkhand, have holidays scheduled around individual festivals. However, the exact closure dates may differ depending on school boards, local administrations and institutional calendars.
 Students and parents should check their respective school holiday notices before making travel or other festive plans, particularly in states where holidays are spread across multiple dates rather than declared as one continuous vacation.
 The festival calendar will also affect schools in Maharashtra, Goa, Gujarat and Chhattisgarh, although the duration of the break varies by region and institution. In Maharashtra, Mumbai's municipal and aided primary schools are scheduled to remain closed from November 5 to November 23, with reopening expected on November 25 after Guru Nanak Jayanti. In Pune, the reported vacation runs from November 5 to November 18, with classes expected to resume on November 19.

 Diwali school holidays 2026: State-wise vacation dates
 The following table provides the reported Diwali vacation schedule and festival-related school holidays across different states. Some dates apply to specific school categories, while others depend on local education department instructions.
 State Holiday dates in November 2026 
 Rajasthan November 4 to 15; reopening November 16 
 Maharashtra (Mumbai municipal and aided primary schools) November 5 to 23; reopening November 25 
 Maharashtra (Pune private secondary schools) November 5 to 18; reopening November 19 
 Goa November 2 to 21 
 Gujarat November 5 to 25 
 Bihar (government schools) November 7 to 17; reopening November 18 
 Chhattisgarh November 6 to 11; reopening November 12 
 Uttar Pradesh November 8, 9 and 11 
 Delhi November 11 for Bhai Dooj, subject to school calendar 
 Haryana November 9 for Vishwakarma Day, subject to school instructions 
 West Bengal Extended Durga Puja vacation until November 12 
 Assam November 8 and 11, with additional local holidays 
 Odisha November 8, 18 and 24 
 Jharkhand November 8, 9 and 11, with Chhath-related holidays from November 13 to 16 
 Diwali 2026: Festival-wise school holidays in November
 Apart from the main Diwali celebration, several festivals falling in November may result in additional school closures. These include Dhanteras, Chhoti Diwali, Govardhan Puja, Bhai Dooj and Chhath Puja. The important dates are:
 Date Day Festival 
 November 6, 2026 Friday Dhanteras 
 November 7, 2026 Saturday Chhoti Diwali/Narak Chaturdashi 
 November 8, 2026 Sunday Diwali/Deepavali 
 November 9, 2026 Monday Govardhan Puja 
 November 11, 2026 Wednesday Bhai Dooj/Bhaiya Dooj 
 November 15, 2026 Sunday Chhath Puja, evening Arghya 
 November 16, 2026 Monday Chhath Puja, morning Arghya 
 November 24, 2026 Tuesday Guru Nanak Jayanti/Kartik Purnima 
 Will schools remain closed after Diwali 2026?
 The duration of school holidays after Diwali will depend on regional festivals and the academic calendars followed by individual institutions. In Bihar, the extended break covers Chitragupt Puja, Bhai Dooj and Chhath Puja, while schools in Rajasthan will resume regular classes on November 16 after their mid-term vacation.
 In states such as Uttar Pradesh, West Bengal and Jharkhand, students may receive additional days off for festivals following Diwali. However, public holidays and restricted holidays do not automatically mean that every school will remain closed.
 Parents and students should check the latest circular issued by their respective schools or state education departments before planning travel or other activities. Government, private, CBSE and ICSE schools may follow different holiday schedules, and local administrations can issue separate instructions.
